name: conduit-e2e
description: Playwright end-to-end tests for the RealWorld Conduit storefront (demo.realworld.show).

scripts.test:ui:all: cross-env TAGS=$TAGS npx playwright test --grep "$(echo $TAGS | sed 's/,/|/g')"
scripts.test:ui:chrome: cross-env TAGS=$TAGS npx playwright test --project=Chrome --grep "$(echo $TAGS | sed 's/,/|/g')"
scripts.test:ui:edge: cross-env TAGS=$TAGS npx playwright test --project=Edge --grep "$(echo $TAGS | sed 's/,/|/g')"
scripts.test:ui:safari: cross-env TAGS=$TAGS npx playwright test --project=Safari --grep "$(echo $TAGS | sed 's/,/|/g')"
